value.title: Held close lost at turn end: the seat's own writes fail the tombstone CAS (F194)

sections.name: body
sections.value:
Root cause, from live memory.turn events in ~/.pij-rs/pij.sqlite: turns DID end ("ended":"turn-end"), but the result was "then":"failed: the close answered 409 Conflict". publish_tombstone (crates/store/src/registry.rs) compares the whole current row to `expected`. The seat's own end-of-turn writes (idle activity) change the row, so the CAS returns E-RS-INCARNATION-CHANGED and the close is dropped. In the bound case the turn ended "bound", then "skipped: the seat was closed during its memory turn". Before you blame the timer or turn-end wiring, read the `then` field.

WIP state, ae1b78d4 on f194-close-memory-turn (pushed, NOT built yet; worktree ~/pi-hacking/pij-f194):
- lifecycle::close_seat now returns CloseRefused{Changed, Other}. memory_turn::proceed re-reads the row and retries up to CLOSE_ATTEMPTS=5 on Changed. On the bound, the reason gets " (memory note may be missing: …)".
- A repeat close while one is pending answers ok with memory_turn{pending:true, deadline_ms} and starts no new turn. A compact meanwhile is refused with E-RS-MEMORY-TURN-PENDING plus deadline_ms. Services.memory_turns is a BTreeMap<seat, PendingTurn>.
- Note rule: `pij directory memory add` publishes a memory.note spine event {project, role, path, commit} for the author. turn_for(Close) skips the turn when the seat's latest memory.note is for a role in its context rows and its `at` is at or after the NEWEST holding start (anchor = holding start, not close request, so a note written before the close was asked still counts).
- Released-only seats take the turn, and turn end closes them; there is never a directory error.
- New tests in memory_turn_http.rs: EndOfTurnWrite liveness wrapper (needs rig_with, which may not exist), the bound test, repeat-close, and note-skip. directory_http asserts memory.note.
Next: one shared-build (clippy and tests for the daemon), fix compile errors (verb(), rig_with, Report.closed, spine.latest_matching signature), docs (pij-rs-api.md memory turn section), PR "Fixes: F194", FINAL to steady-otter. The bound is a POLICY: it decides the close without the note.
